text.headline: Timeline of the United Kingdom
text.text: Major events in the history of the United Kingdom.

events.headline: Norman Conquest
events.text: William the Conqueror defeats Harold at Hastings, beginning Norman rule.

events.headline: Magna Carta
events.text: King John agrees to limits on royal power and the rule of law.

events.headline: English Reformation
events.text: Henry VIII establishes the Church of England.

events.headline: Acts of Union
events.text: England and Scotland unite as Great Britain.

events.headline: Union with Ireland
events.text: The United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland is formed.

events.headline: World War I
events.text: The UK enters WWI with the Allies.

events.headline: Battle of Britain
events.text: RAF successfully defends the UK from Luftwaffe attacks.

events.headline: End of WWII
events.text: Victory followed by decolonization and reconstruction.

events.headline: Joins EEC
events.text: UK joins the European Economic Community.

events.headline: Brexit Completed
events.text: The UK formally leaves the European Union.
